The '''Laboi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Laboi II]] and its primary [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Er'Dox Kaan]].
